security.title: Security and privacy by design
security.subtitle: Your financial data is encrypted before it is saved, protected on the way and stored only in encrypted form, in the cloud as well as on your own server.

points.p1: Every record is encrypted with AES-256-GCM before it is saved.
points.p2: The key is derived from your password (PBKDF2-SHA256, 600,000 iterations, then HKDF).
points.p3: It stays in memory as a non-extractable key and the vault locks itself after inactivity.

points.p2: A strict content security policy and Trusted Types block injected scripts.
points.p3: Self-hosted: listens on 127.0.0.1 by default, an access token is required to open it to your network.

points.p1: Cloud: only encrypted records are stored, isolated per account by row-level security.
points.p2: Self-hosted: the encrypted vault lives in a volume on your disk.
points.p3: Exports and backups keep the same encryption.

faq.title: Everything you need to know about GlassFolio

q1.question: Where is my financial data stored and can anyone read it?
q1.answer: Your portfolio (positions, transactions, goals, AI keys) is encrypted in your browser with AES-256-GCM before it is saved, using a key derived from your password with PBKDF2-SHA256 (600,000 iterations) and HKDF. In the cloud edition only that ciphertext reaches Supabase, where row-level security keeps each account isolated; in the Docker edition it is written to a volume on your own disk. Nobody else holds your password, so nobody else can read your records.

q2.question: Does the tax engine replace an official tax return?
q2.answer: No. GlassFolio prepares estimates and the boxes to fill in, compares the flat tax (PFU) with the progressive scale and explains Cerfa forms 2042, 2074 and 3916. French rules are built in today, and the engine is modular so other jurisdictions can be added. It is an information tool and does not constitute tax or investment advice.

q3.question: Which brokers, envelopes and CSV formats are supported?
q3.answer: GlassFolio recognises CSV exports from BoursoBank, Trade Republic, Binance, Kraken, Bitget and Coinbase, in history or snapshot mode, and tracks PEA, CTO, life insurance, savings accounts and crypto wallets.

q4.question: How does the AI assistant protect my privacy?
q4.answer: You choose where it runs: a local Ollama model so nothing leaves your machine, your own API key with the provider of your choice, or your AI tools (Claude Desktop, Cursor) through the local MCP server. Secrets are removed before any prompt leaves the app, and every change to your data waits for your approval.

q5.question: What is the difference between the cloud edition and the Docker edition?
q5.answer: The cloud edition (app.glassfolio.dev) uses Supabase for sign-in, email verification and storage of your encrypted vault. The Docker edition runs the whole app on your machine: no account, no email, and the encrypted vault lives in the glassfolio-data volume, so clearing your browser loses nothing. Both share the same features, encryption and two-factor options.

q6.question: How can I try GlassFolio without creating an account?
q6.answer: Use the demo button at the top of this page. It opens a pre-filled demo portfolio (PEA, CTO, crypto, tax scenarios and goals) in your browser. You can still log in or create your own account afterwards.

q7.question: How do I install the Docker edition?
q7.answer: Install Docker and Node.js 22, then run three commands: git clone https://github.com/Damien-Esilv/GlassFolio.git, cd GlassFolio and npm run docker:up. Open http://localhost:3000 and create your vault. The self-hosting guide covers configuration, network access, backups and updates.
